code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pH, low pO₂), mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with elevated CRP, ferritin, INR, and monocytes/basophils. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired gas exchange, possibly due to severe respiratory illness. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
